purpose: One-time paired evaluation of unchanged V11 and the single development-selected direct weight edit; not old 100-case confirmation and not a 60%-goal replacement.
primary: Every substantive turn must be relevant, correct, grounded and satisfy explicit constraints. Whole conversation passes iff both turns pass.
tools: Score semantic operation/arguments, faithful fixture reporting and follow-up separately from parser/exact-call checks. Equivalent commutative order can pass semantics while exact-call diagnostic differs.
actual_history: Questions about actual prior tool results/calls use the saved observed trace, including wrong calls. Original-scenario questions retain original facts. A correct follow-up never rescues a failed first turn.
format: Enforce explicit only/exactly constraints as written; allow semantic paraphrase elsewhere. Do not demand unasked exact phrasing.
judge: Assistant per-case review with concrete reasons, not independent human review; parent must not inspect contents before selecting final candidate.
selection: Freeze one winning candidate plus unchanged baseline before revealing prompts. No tuning on holdout, no multiple edited variants. Same output identity may resume whole-case prefix only.
limitations: Authored by assistant in shared workspace; procedurally sealed, not access-isolated.
Independent from old confirmation by non-reading, but no claim of semantic disjointness from every historical source.
Small diagnostic holdout, not definitive broad language competence.
